rationale: A shoot-down event and a seeker limitation are different assertions.
Units' presence and a Ukrainian claim of their losses are different assertions.
The commander's identity and the brigade's blame are different facts.
The men's letter in A (half the equipment lost in four days) matches B's set-piece summary, citing the same ISW report.
The tank's specifications and the first Bradley's failed pass are different facts.
The crew's mission count and the change of aim are different claims.
A shoot-down time and the sea's geography share only place names.
A date bound and the crew's mission count are different assertions.
The tank's manoeuvre and an expert's view of crew panic are different assertions.
The sinking and the location of a different strike share only a place name.
A specific recall order and the general basing of Su-34s and Su-35s are different assertions.
B's observed sequence of hits under CIWS fire backs A's account of the Ivanovets sinking under AK-630M fire, from a shared TWZ source.
Imagery of a blackened A-50 at Ivanovo-Severny backs B's statement that Spiderweb reached the A-50 base, from a shared Kyiv Post source.
The river's course and a November attack share only place names.
B's TB2 kills of the Strela-10 and ZU-23-2 confirm A's presence of those systems on the island, from a shared TWZ source.
A's 3rd Tank Brigade at Balakliia matches B's battle list for the brigade, from a shared Wikipedia source.
The 18:00 recording and the 22:00 capture announcement are different events.
A strike on a ferry and the location of the ferries are different assertions.
B gives the battery counts behind A's statement that S-300, Buk-M1 and S-125 were the backbone, from the same RUSI report.
The pocket's fall and the parade of prisoners are different events.
A's first launches with no hits match B's statement that the February Neptunes failed, from the same Pravda source.
A date bound and the volume of fire are different assertions.
General basing of Su-34s and Su-35s and a shoot-down spree are different assertions.
A's hull turning to aim the AIM-9M matches B's point that the V7 must point at its target.

A claimed shoot-down and a later recall of sorties are different events.

Same September 2022 refusal by Musk of Starlink coverage around Crimea, same source.
The column's movement and road type are different facts.
B says Gerasimov's claim that Kupiansk was taken was undercut by Zelensky's video in the town on 12 December.
The villages' capture and a kill claim are different assertions.
A names-only loss floor and a prisoner claim are different assertions.
UK Defence Intelligence's assessment is the basis for A's statement that the Navy limited itself to the eastern Black Sea, with a shared source.
Ihnat's comment and a milblogger friendly-fire claim are different assertions.
Both have the Il-22 hit at about 21:00 on 14 January 2024 and turning for Anapa, from shared sources.
A's boat crossing at Novomlynsk near Dvorichna is the route B describes, from the same source.
B places A's new Svatove–Kreminna line on the R66 with coordinates.
Ihnat's comment and the recall of sorties are different assertions.
A claimed surrender count and a volunteer's explanation of the surrender are different assertions.
